classification: Already recorded historical adult cross-sectional primary study, not a new-window publication.
summary: Thirty adults with Tourette syndrome and 30 controls performed direct/indirect force matching. The reported direct-condition association and indirect null do not establish a formal interaction, causal mechanism, prospective prediction or treatment efficacy.
new_access_observation: Wiley landing page explicitly lists aggregate supplement S1–S4 with group mean/SD and exploratory hierarchical regression descriptions. The exact aggregate download returned HTTP 403, so no numerical table was inspected.
access_result: HTTP 403 from web reader; no repeated or alternate-route attempt.
decision: Keep fixed precision audit closed pending lawful aggregate methods/tables. Do not duplicate the existing evidence record or count a listing as access to its contents. Funding is listed as Italian Ministry of Health Ricerca Corrente Project RC L3070; conflicts not independently cleared.
